name: Server-Side Injection Testing
description: Identification and exploitation of server-side injection vulnerabilities beyond SQL injection. Covers server-side request forgery (SSRF), XML external entity injection (XXE), server-side template injection (SSTI), OS command injection, LDAP injection, XPath injection, and expression language injection. Each class requires understanding the underlying technology context to identify, confirm, and demonstrate impact.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to server-side injection testing beyond SQLi

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the major server-side injection classes and how they differ from SQL injection
evidence: Can explain SSRF, XXE, SSTI, and OS command injection at a conceptual level
Understands why each injection class requires different detection and exploitation approaches
Aware of the relevant CWEs and OWASP categories for each class

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can detect and confirm server-side injection vulnerabilities in lab environments under supervision
evidence: Identifies SSRF via out-of-band callbacks in controlled exercises
Detects and exploits basic XXE for file disclosure in lab environments
Tests for OS command injection using time-based and out-of-band techniques
Findings reviewed and confirmed by authorized tester

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently identifies and exploits server-side injection across multiple classes
evidence: Identifies SSRF in real engagements including blind variants with out-of-band confirmation
Exploits XXE across XML parsers with varying configurations
Detects and exploits SSTI across common template engines
Tests for OS command injection including filter bypass and chained execution
Produces clear findings with demonstrated impact for each injection class

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Exploits complex injection scenarios; chains injection classes; mentors others
evidence: Chains SSRF into internal service exploitation and cloud metadata access
Exploits XXE for out-of-band data exfiltration and SSRF via DTD
Identifies SSTI in non-obvious contexts and achieves code execution
Discovers injection in non-standard parameters (headers, file uploads, serialized data)
Mentors junior testers on injection methodology across all classes

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on server-side injection; discovers novel vectors; develops methodology
evidence: Published research or CVEs related to server-side injection vulnerabilities
Developed the lab's server-side injection testing methodology
Discovers novel injection vectors in modern frameworks and cloud-native applications
Trains teams on advanced injection techniques

assessment_methods.description: Identify and exploit SSRF, XXE, SSTI, and command injection in a prepared application with varying contexts and defenses
Review server-side injection findings from recent engagements for accuracy, impact demonstration, and completeness across injection classes
